description: This file defines the AOR_Scheduled_Reports class for managing scheduled report configurations in SuiteCRM, including recipient parsing, schedule checking, and email retrieval.

classes.name: AOR_Scheduled_Reports
classes.description: Represents scheduled report configurations, handles recipient parsing, schedule evaluation, and email retrieval.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates support for specific interfaces, e.g., ACL.

methods.name: save

methods.name: get_email_recipients

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines if the scheduled report should run at a given date.

methods.name: parseRecipients
